results.title: Troubleshooting | OpenCode
results.description: Common issues and how to resolve them · To debug issues with OpenCode, start by checking the logs and local data it stores on disk

results.title: Anthropic models fail with 404 on GitHub Enterprise (GHE.com) · Issue #11105 · anomalyco/opencode
results.description: The Copilot /models API returns a supported_endpoints array for each model. ... GHE does not support /v1/messages for Anthropic models. Downgrade to OpenCode v1.1.36 which uses /chat/completions for all models.

results.title: [Bug]: OpenCode Zen returns 404 despite correct baseUrl configuration · Issue #8159 · openclaw/openclaw
results.description: The 404 response is an HTML page from opencode.ai, indicating the request goes to /zen/messages instead of /zen/v1/messages · Related to Issue #1416 - the resolveOpencodeZenModelApi() function may still be routing Anthropic-format models (claude-*) ...

results.title: Troubleshooting | OpenCode
results.description: If you encounter API call errors, this may be due to outdated provider packages. opencode dynamically installs provider packages (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.) as needed and caches them locally.

results.title: Providers | OpenCode
results.description: And for all other OpenAI-compatible providers, use @ai-sdk/openai-compatible (for /v1/chat/completions); if a model uses /v1/responses, use @ai-sdk/openai. For mixed setups under one provider, you can override per model via provider.npm. Check correct API endpoint is used in the options.baseURL field.
